pages.title: ScaleSight | Managed Inventory Planning for Food & Beverage
pages.description: Weekly specialist-reviewed recommendations on what to buy, make or replenish, how much, when and the cash each option commits. Your team makes the final call.

pages.title: Planning Workspace | ScaleSight Decision Intelligence
pages.description: See the evidence, assumptions, alternatives and reviewed recommendation behind one planning question. Workspace scope and interactions are agreed for each engagement.

pages.title: How ScaleSight Works | Managed Planning & Review
pages.description: Agree the decision and inputs, check changing demand and supply, compare feasible responses and review the recommendation. Your team approves and executes.

pages.title: Illustrative Planning Examples | ScaleSight
pages.description: Explore synthetic supply-timing and production-mix concepts: evidence, alternatives and the recommendation to review before committing cash. These are not client results.

pages.title: 30-Day Planning Pilot | ScaleSight
pages.description: Test managed analytical planning on one upcoming buy, production run or allocation choice. A focused paid 30-day pilot with scope and fee agreed before work begins.

pages.description: ScaleSight connects data-science analysis and practical planning review to production, purchasing, replenishment and allocation decisions for food and beverage brands.
